RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

An all-male panel selecting a male candidate with fewer formal qualifications can signal unconscious affinity bias, but panel composition alone does not prove discrimination. Municipal hiring often weighs subjective factors such as interview performance, council relationships, and political fit. 

Do not accuse the municipality of bias yet. Premature accusations make employers defensive and can damage local professional networks. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your debrief, or submit a public records request for the scoring rubrics and interview notes. Consult an employment attorney before raising gender explicitly; do so only if the records reveal procedural irregularities, moving target criteria, or inconsistent scoring.
